pr_title: Bluetooth: controller: df: fix handling of max count of IQ reports
pr_body:
There was an error in handling of max number of IQ reports
generated by controller. Accordin to BT Core Spec 5.1 the host
may request a number of CTEs to be sampled and reported by
controller while enable IQ sampling. The max_cte_count value
set to zero means sample all CTEs in a periodic advertising chain.

The commit fixes wrong handling of the max_cte_count provided
value to generate expected number of IQ reports.

Signed-off-by: Piotr Pryga <piotr.pryga@nordicsemi.no>
pr_comments:
The PR fixes: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/39263
Added `backport-v2.7-branch` label because PR fixes an issue in LTS.

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: controller: DF: wrong handling of max_cte_count
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
When there is a periodic advertising sync established and CTE is enabled Host may request a number of CTE to be received and sampled for the sync. One of possible values provided by Host zero, that would request from controller to receive and sample all CTEs transmitted in periodic advertising chain. The information is provided by Host in HCI_LE_Set_Connectionless_IQ_Sampling_Enable command (`Max_Sampled_CTEs` parameter). 

**To Reproduce**
Use `direction_finding_connectionless_tx` sample to TX more than 1 CTE in a periodic advertising chain.
Use `direction_finding_connectionless_rx` sample to RX all CTE in periodic advertising chain.
Set:
```
	const struct bt_df_per_adv_sync_cte_rx_param cte_rx_params = {
		.max_cte_count = 0,
		.cte_type = BT_DF_CTE_TYPE_AOD_1US | BT_DF_CTE_TYPE_AOD_2US,
	};
```

It will cause no IQ reports to be provided.

**Expected behavior**
Receive the same number of IQ reports as periodic advertising reports.

review_comments: Should this be conditional, i.e. only on `cfg->max_cte_count == CONTINUOUS_CTE_SAMPLING`  ?

No it should not. It should be evaluated when `cfg->max_cte_count < CONTINUOUS_CTE_SAMPLING`.
In case if `cfg->max_cte_count == CONTINUOUS_CTE_SAMPLING` is it not needed. Even though I left it because cost for one addition is smaller than `if` + addition in case of `cfg->max_cte_count < CONTINUOUS_CTE_SAMPLING`.
